g.text: Global: expected log-likelihood of p1 for every slice
Local: where the expected log-likelihood peaks under the working correlation
Data from the true law (p*, rho_1*, rho_2), scored with a working rho_1 (y axis); white dashed: true rho_1*; red dotted: maximiser on the grid;
white contour: drop of 1.92 from the maximum of each row (expected 95% likelihood-ratio region under the working model).
small centroid gap / balanced, p* = (0.50, 0.50); population law sum_j p_j^2 R_j against single-cell law sum_j p_j R_j
Working-covariance sensitivity: a wrong correlation of type 1 moves the maximiser of p1
